description: Viabilità di interesse silvo-pastorale proposta is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizi.piemonte.it. Geographical data on the proposed forest-pastoral roads, produced by IPLA on the basis of the data collected during the studies for the Regional Forestry Plans of the Piedmont Region (conventionally updated to the year 2000). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Proposed silvo-pastoral traffic" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, RNDT. The listing shows 2012-11-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
